head_note: The SHA at the moment this file was WRITTEN, one commit behind the commit that carries it — a handoff cannot record its own commit. Verify with `git -C <repo> rev-parse HEAD`, never by trusting this field.
completed_this_session: Replayed edition 2 against the current pipeline and answered ADR-001's open follow-up with a rate instead of an n=1 draw: 40 generated lines, 14 non-pass, 10 of those in TWO items while four items sat at 0/20. One item invents an attribution in 8 of 10 samples across two runs with 696 characters of ground, so the strip and the ground floor do not touch that class.

Built the replay capability itself. DIGEST-EVAL §3d had claimed the shortlist 'can be replayed rather than waited for' — EDITIONS_DIR was write-only in fetch-news.mjs, so the capability the paragraph leaned on did not exist.

Extracted the model calls into scripts/news/summarise.mjs so the prompt has one owner and three callers; fetch-news.mjs runs its pipeline at import, so a replay could not import summarizeEn without fetching 37 feeds.
Code-reviewed #29, #30, #31, #32, #33. Found and fixed a greeting strip in #30 that ate ordinary prose and cut mid-word, before trimToBoundary could repair it.
Corrected a misfiled invention count: 'addressing competition' is grounded in the source ('frente à concorrencia'), so the invention column held three where it holds two.
Merged all six PRs and verified the deploy by effect — the 2026-09-10 post went 404 to 200 while the control stayed 404, and the human-corrected AI-MEMORY line is what is live.

measured.model_line_quality: 40 lines, 5 samples of 8 items, strip + ground floor active: 14 non-pass. Concentration matters more than the rate — 10 of 14 are two items.
measured.ground_floor_value: Converts the This Week In React item from a silent false `pass` on a wholly invented sentence into `tautological`, 5 of 5. A false negative became an honest non-verdict.
measured.relation_lane_exposure: Was 'zero measured production exposure'. Now 2 relations in grounds, 3 comparable across 40 summaries, 0 conflicts. No longer never-exercised; still too thin to validate.
measured.instability: The same item flips between pass and fail across samples, so edition 1's 'zero survived' and edition 2's '5 of 8 survived' are both single draws. Neither number was ever load-bearing.

remaining_tasks: Monday 2026-09-14 08:00 — the first digest from the DETERMINISTIC pipeline (summarisation is now opt-in). Read `RESULT=` in scripts/news/digest.log, never the exit code; a log with no `RESULT=` line at all is a third state. Then read `TRANSLATED n/m` — n short of m means that many PT lines are COPIES.

File the two review follow-ups that have no issues: #29's numeric false positive ($1 million against a source writing $1,000,000, measured at 3 of 9 findings) and #31's edition record gaining `translated` while schemaVersion stays 1 (absent and false become indistinguishable).
The reviews for #29/#31/#32/#33 exist only in the session transcript, not on the PRs, which are now closed. If they matter, they belong in docs.

G1/G2: the sub-60-character groundless band (7 excerpts) and §3c's strip frequencies cannot be recomputed from the repo — the 94-item corpus is pulled live, not tracked. Closing either needs a live fetch.

human_actions_pending.context: It merged unreviewed by anyone but its author — the module extraction and the replay harness. Flagged before merging and still true.

decisions.decision: The model's summarisation still does not earn its place
decisions.rationale: 40 lines, 14 non-pass, human lane 8/8. The strip and ground floor do not touch the invention class. Nothing here argues for flipping --llm-summary on by default.

decisions.decision: Extract the prompt into its own module rather than copy it into the replay
decisions.rationale: Two copies of a prompt diverge in silence, and the replay would then measure a prompt nobody ships. Same reason excerpt.mjs was split out.

decisions.decision: Build the replay on the stack tip rather than on main
decisions.rationale: #31 rewrites fetch-news.mjs heavily; a replay flag on main would conflict with it, and the tip is the pipeline the replay should exercise.

decisions.decision: Rebase each stacked branch onto main rather than merge
decisions.rationale: main takes commits by rebase, so the same content arrived under different SHAs and every stacked branch came up DIRTY. Rebasing drops the duplicates by patch-id and leaves exactly each PR's own commits.

next_action: Nothing is in flight. If resuming before Monday, the useful work is the two follow-up issues; the digest itself is gated on the clock and needs no run.
context_notes: The through-line this session was that almost every wrong turn came from an instrument answering confidently about the wrong state, and every one was caught by a control rather than by care. A grep pattern returned 0 for text that was present. A zsh parameter modifier made `git show` return something other than the file, and I nearly reported that the stack had lost a fix. A gate waiter reported a stale green three times running. A CONTRACT rule written outside its yaml fence was ignored in silence, exit 0, and I nearly read that as the validator having no teeth. `node --check` passed a file whose import did not resolve. In every case the thing that separated 'no finding' from 'blind instrument' was printing a positive control beside the zero, in the same run.
